# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The gate files 214 assertions at the committed tree (D108: 216 only while another
# stream's uncommitted V7__share_links.sql is on disk, so a count off this file is a count of one plane); D102
# measured that the ledgers name somewhere between 53 and 57 of them depending on how the text is matched, and
# that a mention is only an upper bound on being witnessed. What has never existed is a machine-readable record
# of the stronger claim — "this row was seen red" — because every plant this lane has run lives in a temp-dir
# harness and a paragraph of prose. A count of witnesses that cannot be recomputed is a story, so this is the
# record, and scripts/check_falsifier_registry.mjs checks it against the gate's own list of rows rather than
# against anyone's memory.
# RULES, enforced by the checker:
#   * `check` must be an assertion the gate actually files, read back from `qc` in a loaded database. The
#     polymorphic sweeps build their names at run time, so a name here that is not in qc is a transcription.
#   * `witness` is a commit that still resolves, or a path inside this repository that is tracked at HEAD
#     (D113: it used to allow "a file that still exists", which in practice meant 39 rows pointing into one
#     machine's temporary directory -- the copies now live in data/seed/falsifier_witnesses/). Not a description.
#   * One row per (check, arm). A check witnessed by three arms is three rows; the claim being recorded is
